posts.text: Agree this risk is always there. Its a small sign of improvement management claiming that chinese dump is coming down in the Q1 FY27 concall and numbers also reflect the same… the raw material prices are also going up and company is able to do passthrough the same indicating things improving slowly. Hope situation improves from here on. Govt is also looking to reduce import duty on vegetable oil. If this happens (which I believe chances are high due to high inflation and poor monsoon this year will also add on to this).
